input.content: Search X for substantive, recent posts about: the most notable technology, AI, and crypto stories today, with priority on AI agents that transact onchain, agent-payment rails, x402, AI-judged bounty/escrow protocols, and decentralized AI oracles. For EACH post return: @handle, the full text, date posted, exact engagement counts (likes, retweets, replies; 0 if unknown), and the direct link https://x.com/handle/status/ID. Return a numbered list.
